$comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment (environments-and-promotion). Additive-only: adds the Environments index page (register/schema-driven CRUD over the `environment` schema, same declarative type:index pattern already used by Sources/Endpoints/etc — no bespoke Vue page, matching the Catalog page's own 'Standard type:index ... NO custom page' precedent) plus its menu entry, and wires a 'Promote configuration' header action into that page that opens PromotePreviewModal via the modal bus (config-group + target-environment selection happens INSIDE the modal, same pattern as ExportConfigurationDialog's own configuration-group picker). Deliberately does NOT overlay/replace the existing 'Catalog' page (buildManifest's mergePages() replaces an existing page id WHOLESALE, not by field-patch — copying the whole Catalog page definition into this fragment just to add one headerAction would risk silent drift if Catalog's own definition changes elsewhere).

pages.title: Environments
pages._note: environments-and-promotion: environment CRUD list (REQ-001) over the `environment` schema. The promote flow is reachable from this page's 'Promote configuration' header action (design.md 'promote flow reachable from a configuration group's existing actions' — surfaced here rather than duplicated onto Catalog, see fragment-level $comment) and opens PromotePreviewModal, which lets the operator pick BOTH the configuration group and the target environment.
